UI remains the contract.
Do not redesign Runtime semantics in the Builder. The Builder reads and navigates governed historical state; Runtime owns reconstruction semantics.

Bashnpm run build
Then stop for visual validation.

Bashgit add ...
git commit ...
git push

Do not reintroduce literal \n text into JSX.
What To Do Next
Do not immediately commit M46 Phase 1 unless you decide Phase 1 itself should be a separately locked milestone.
The stated objective is to complete the full cross-navigation task, so the preferred continuation is to finish M46 before locking.
Recommended M46 Phase 2
Implement reverse and peer traversal so Historical Artifacts is not a navigation dead end.
The next production-grade slice should allow a selected artifact to navigate to related reconstruction surfaces based only on existing Runtime IDs.
Recommended behavior:
For a selected Event in Historical Artifact Explorer:
Open in Temporal Chronology
Open related Relationships
Open governing Episode   // only if an Episode actually exists
For a selected Source:
Open related Relationships
Open related Events
Open governing Episode   // only when Runtime membership exists
For a selected Episode:
Open member Events
Open member Relationships
Do not fabricate links. Use only:
source.eventIds
source.episodeIds
episode.eventIds
episode.relationshipIds
relationship.from
relationship.to
chronology entry eventId
Architectural Recommendation
Do not keep piling independent navigation state into every inspector.
Before Phase 2, inspect whether the cleanest production contract is a small shared Builder-only navigation controller, likely something like:
GenesisHistoricalNavigationState
GenesisHistoricalNavigationTarget
navigateToChronology(...)
navigateToRelationship(...)
navigateToArtifact(...)
navigateToEpisode(...)
This controller must remain purely navigational.
It must not:
create Historical Events
create Relationships
create Episodes
infer causality
alter confidence
mutate temporal authority
write Runtime state
Preferred End-State for M46
A historical object should be navigable bidirectionally:
Chronology Event
    ↕
Historical Artifact Event
    ↕
Relationships
    ↕
Episode
    ↕
Sources
where links exist only when Runtime already projects those identities.
UI Requirements For M46 Continuation
Preserve current certified Genesis layout.
Do not redesign the panels.
Navigation actions should be subtle, premium, and secondary.
Use existing Lumina primitives:
LuminaButton
LuminaFlagshipPanel
LuminaFlagshipCard
LuminaSectionNavigator
No horizontal scrolling inside inspector content.
Lists should use:
overflow-y-auto
overflow-x-hidden
overscroll-contain
[scrollbar-gutter:stable]
[touch-action:pan-y]
Keep each major region full-width and vertically stacked.
Testing Requirement
Add explicit cross-navigation tests rather than relying only on SSR content tests.
At minimum M46 should verify:
Chronology Event → Historical Artifact Event
Relationship source endpoint → Historical Artifact Source
Relationship event endpoint → Historical Artifact Event
Episode → Historical Artifact Episode
Phase 2 should additionally test reverse navigation.
If component-level interaction testing infrastructure already exists, use it.
Do not introduce a new test framework unnecessarily.
Final M46 Lock Requirements
Before committing:
Bashnpm --workspace apps/lumina-builder test -- \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/...

npm run build

git diff --check
Then visually validate the full cross-navigation.
